method: Every refereed paper attributed to a mission at or under the cost threshold was sorted into one of six kinds by what role the mission's own flight data play in it, from its title, abstract, journal and keywords: science results, data and calibration, mission and instrument, reviews and commentary, planned or expected results, or mentions only. The sorting was done by an AI language model following a written rubric and was spot-checked by The Planetary Society; every paper that is not a science result carries a one-line reason, and the whole list is published with the data so that any call can be checked or corrected.
